verdict.rationale: Docs show real-time authorization decisioning (webhook), balance/funding account access, and 'full transaction visibility' for agent cards, which cover some real-time money-movement visibility, but there is no explicit evidence of a transaction ledger tying each authorization to its clearing entry or of settlement reporting that reconciles to the penny. missing for 10: explicit ledger/ledger-entry API linking authorization-to-clearing, settlement/reconciliation reporting with penny-level accuracy, independent finance-team corroboration.
